value.a: The sieve is DETERMINISTIC PYTHON ONLY. The LLM is in the parameter-adjustment loop, never in the measurement path.
This is the learns-its-gates founding intention made concrete for one gate shape.
Hex is the inference target (the M1 Studio box), not CC. CC is too expensive for periodic review.
The schedule fires from a probe — an event that already fires (the heartbeat, or a feedback-count threshold) — never a new timer or daemon.
